claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Tiabendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic that at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive against human cancer cell lines, since its antiparasitic action depends on binding nematode beta-tubulin and it lacks potent cytotoxicity against human cells at low micromolar concentrations.
